name: Pinned Details Card
job: Show the details of the row the reader picked without leaving the full-width grid: a card pinned bottom-right on wide screens, a block below the content on narrow ones.

anatomy.role: The grid takes the full width (`minmax(0,1fr)`); the card is its sibling
`position:fixed`, 16px from the bottom-right, `min(25rem, 100vw - 32px)` wide, at most 50vh tall, scrolls inside, no scrim; depth from an offset plus soft-blur shadow, no hairline
Sits below the content in flow with a hairline border; a Back control instead of the X
Title (focus target), one meta line, optional summary; the 44px X top-right
Hairline-split; heading in a 9.5rem left column once the card is 520px wide (container query)

states.name: Narrow (in flow)
states.note: Below the content, bordered. This is what phones and tablets in portrait see.

states.name: Wide (pinned)
states.note: Shown here in place; on the live page it floats bottom-right and rows stay clickable behind it.

use_when: A full-width grid or list whose rows each carry a page of detail, and the reader compares rows one after another.
Non-modal on purpose: no scrim, rows stay clickable, picking another row swaps the card's content.
avoid_when: Do not use it for a decision the reader must finish first; that is a dialog.
Do not draw a hairline border plus a wide shadow on the pinned card; one offset plus soft-blur shadow carries the depth.
Do not let it grow past half the window height; it scrolls inside.

data.note: Kind, day, hours; joined by dots on one line.
Status, What you get, Good to know, and so on; empty sections are left out.
The row that opened it; focus goes back there on close.

access: A `section` labelled by its title (`aria-labelledby`), with `aria-live=polite` so a swapped row is announced.
Opening moves focus to the title (`tabindex=-1`); the X (`Close details`) or Escape closes it and focus returns to the row.
Wide: `overscroll-behavior:contain` keeps a scroll inside the card from moving the page.
Slide-in respects `prefers-reduced-motion`. Rem sizes; at the largest text size the card scrolls rather than clips.

used_by.name: Approved My Ally Step 1 template (public/myally-hub.html, PR 2094)

gates: `kit_specimen.py --check` (in scripts): this page matches its spec.
`kit_primitive_sync.py --check` (in scripts): every page that marks this block carries it unchanged.
Reading-options check: 375 and 1280, light and dark, largest text size, roomy spacing and the easy-read font.
